description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 score, comparing two different conditions. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.5 to 1.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 score as a percentage, also on a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: a pink line with circle markers and a solid line style, representing one condition, and a purple line with circle markers and a solid line style, labeled "w/o material information". The pink line starts at around 55% at 0.5 tokens, peaks at approximately 58% at 1.0 tokens, and then declines to around 51% at 1.5 tokens. The purple line begins at around 52.5% at 0.5 tokens, remains relatively stable until 1.3 tokens where it is around 53%, and then decreases to around 48% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines have shaded regions around them, indicating the uncertainty or variability in the data.
